s6.application: screen_form_open builds draft and from_profile, carry first for a new draft, then calls follow_profile on every non-sample open; profile_differs is applied later in opened_json for legacy no-baseline drafts.
s6.follow: follow_profile only for Draft with profile_baseline: unedited profile boxes follow when current draft value still equals baseline; edited keys in profile_edits never move. Changes are quietly saved and page receives profile_updates.
s6.legacy: A Draft with no baseline is never changed on open; profile_differs lists differing unedited boxes and sets baseline in memory; page offers Use profile values.
s6.lock: host emits locks/profile/profile_edit in opened_json. TS session isLocked uses host lock unless key is in profileEdit and currently editing. startProfileEdit adds keys to editing/opened; end keeps value but restores locked look.
s6.differing_locked_box: page shows the differs banner with Use profile values plus per-item Edit; Edit opens the box/catalog on this return only.
